tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The tenant's brand colour; the owner sets it in Setup (default #5b6cff). Never used raw for text or fills: every brand tone below derives from it.

tokens.name: brand-2
tokens.usage: The tenant's accent (default #16a34a). Reserved for the owner's second colour in Setup; the UI itself paints nothing with it today.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-solid buttons and the brand-mark monogram. The app switches it to #0b0b0d when the brand colour's luminance is above 0.42.

tokens.name: brand-solid
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active tab underline, selected table-row bar, form accent-color. In code: color-mix(in oklab, brand 92%, black) light / 88% dark; these are the resolved values for the default brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill (darker in light, lighter in dark). Derived from brand in code.

tokens.name: brand-fg
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and icons: links, the Trace link, active sidebar icon, citation file icon, focus ring. 7.5:1 on panel in light, 8.6:1 in dark. Derived from brand in code.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Brand tint: brand badge fill, selected table row, citation chip hover, active command-palette icon well. Derived from brand and panel in code.

tokens.name: brand-soft-2
tokens.usage: Stronger brand tint: Avatar fill, highlighted source lines in the citation viewer. Derived from brand and panel in code.

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Brand-tinted border: brand badge ring, Avatar ring, running step border, citation chip hover border. Derived from brand and line in code.

tokens.name: brand-ring
tokens.usage: The 3px focus ring around inputs (brand at 26% alpha light, 40% dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px outline on every focus-visible control (offset 2px). Alias of brand-fg.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: App chrome: the html background and the sidebar. Also the PWA theme-color.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind cards. The header is bg at 82% over a blur.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, modals, drawers, popovers, the phone tab bar (86% over a blur).

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: code blocks, run-step rows, segmented-control track, command palette footer, Empty background at 60%.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, ghost buttons and sidebar links; the subtle button's resting fill; the chart cursor.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Pressed wash; the subtle button's hover fill.

tokens.name: side-ink
tokens.usage: Inactive sidebar link text on side. 7.3:1 light, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: side-active
tokens.usage: The active sidebar link's fill.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, drawers and the command palette (with a 2–3px blur).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on side, bg, panel and panel-2. 17.9:1 light, 15.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, ghost-button text, JSON blocks, plan lists, citation chip text. 11.3:1 on panel.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, hints, table heads, breadcrumbs, inactive tabs, chart ticks. At least 5.2:1 on side, bg, panel and panel-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decoration only: breadcrumb chevrons, pending-step clock, the AI-offline dot. 2.7:1 on panel: never text.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text on panel. 4.6:1 light, 5.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card border, input border, header and sidebar edges, table head rule, Kbd border.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Quieter hairline: card-header and modal-header rules, table body rows, inline code border, the hero grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on cards, inputs and secondary buttons; Empty's dashed border; axis lines; scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on panel (done steps, positive Stat values, the AI-connected dot). 5.0:1 light, 10.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint: good badges and pills.

tokens.name: good-ink
tokens.usage: Text on good-soft. 6.8:1 light.

tokens.name: good-line
tokens.usage: Ring on good-soft.

tokens.name: good-solid
tokens.usage: The good button's fill under white text (5.0:1).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Danger text and icons on panel: the danger button's label, failed steps, negative Stat values. 5.8:1 light, 6.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Danger tint: ErrorBox, bad badges, blocked guardrail flags, danger button hover.

tokens.name: bad-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bad-soft. 7.3:1 light.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border on bad-soft and the danger button's hover border.

tokens.name: bad-solid
tokens.usage: Solid danger fill under white text (declared; no component uses it yet).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on panel (warn Stat values). 5.0:1 light, 10.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint: warn badges, review-level guardrail flags, the Reconnecting pill.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warn-soft. 7.4:1 light.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border on warn-soft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on panel. 5.0:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info tint: info badges (Replayed AI, Needs AI budget, running runs).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft. 7.1:1 light.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border on info-soft.

tokens.name: demo
tokens.usage: The fictional-data signal, violet. Icons for demo content on panel.

tokens.name: demo-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the DEMO and PITCH DEMO badges.

tokens.name: demo-ink
tokens.usage: Text on demo-soft. 7.3:1 light.

tokens.name: demo-line
tokens.usage: Ring on demo-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge fill, inline code background, skeleton base.

tokens.name: neutral-line
tokens.usage: Neutral badge ring.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: First chart series: the brand (in dark, brand lightened 80% toward white).

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series, teal. 3.7:1 on panel in light: for fills, not text.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series, amber. 3.2:1 on panel in light: for fills, not text.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series, purple.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series, rose.

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: Funnel and ordered-stage ramp, lightest step (brand 28% over panel).

tokens.name: ramp-2
tokens.usage: Ramp step 2 (brand 40%).

tokens.name: ramp-3
tokens.usage: Ramp step 3 (brand 52%).

tokens.name: ramp-4
tokens.usage: Ramp step 4 (brand 64%).

tokens.usage: Ramp step 5 (brand 76%).

families.sans: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: The Day One and sign-in hero line. In code it is fluid: clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 44px). Balanced wrapping; the brand name inside it is painted brand-fg.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Page titles (PageHeader) and the sign-in heading. One per page.

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Card titles, modal and drawer titles, run titles.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.sample: Your programme's AI. Nothing goes out without your approval.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display line; painted muted.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Everything outbound waits here for a person.
styles.usage: Body copy, inputs, PageHeader subtitles. The body default is 14px/1.5 with letter-spacing -0.006em.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: A sequence starts only once the first message is confirmed sent.
styles.usage: Dense copy: Empty hints, breadcrumbs, the sidebar user name, segmented labels.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Captions, Stat hints, table heads, Field hints, palette footer; painted muted.

styles.name: t-overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a title or a trace section; painted muted.

styles.name: ui-button-md
styles.usage: Button size md (36px), sidebar links, tabs, table cells, run-step labels, toast text, ErrorBox.

styles.name: ui-button-lg
styles.usage: Button size lg (44px), the Day One CTA.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Field labels (ink-2), Stat labels and card subtitles (muted).

styles.name: ui-badge
styles.usage: Badge and citation chip text. The DEMO badge adds weight 600 and 0.04em tracking.

styles.name: ui-mono
styles.usage: JSON blocks, source lines and step input/output. Inline code is 0.92em of its parent.

spacing.note: The app declares no spacing variables of its own: it uses Tailwind 4's default 4px scale through utilities. These are the steps the components actually use.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Tailwind 0.5. Badge dot gap; gap-y between wrapped badge lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal gap, tab-list gap, Kbd padding, segmented inner padding (p-0.5 = 2px) companions.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button md gap, Field label-to-control gap, badge inline padding, breadcrumb gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button lg gap, action-group gap, Pill and Kbd padding, toast gap, sidebar brand row gap (10px) companions.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button sm padding-x, segmented padding-x, header icon gap, card-hover list spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card header padding-y, table cell padding-x, modal header padding-y, toast padding-left, header padding-x on phones.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Button md padding-x, ErrorBox padding-x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card body padding on phones, Stat padding, header padding-x on desktop (20px) companion, sidebar brand row padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card body padding from the sm breakpoint, button lg padding-x, header padding-x on desktop, Tabs bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: PageHeader bottom margin (28px from md), modal page padding on desktop, Empty padding-x.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: The hero-surface grid pitch; PageHeader bottom margin on desktop; Day One CTA top margin.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty state padding-y; sign-in hero padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Sign-in hero padding at xl.

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Inputs, run-step rows, ErrorBox, segmented track, chart tooltips, the user row in the sidebar footer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, Empty states and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the command palette; the top corners of a phone-sheet modal.

tokens.name: sh-xs
tokens.usage: Resting card, input and Kbd shadow.

tokens.name: sh-sm
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a Segmented control.

tokens.name: sh-md
tokens.usage: Hovered card (card-hover) and chart tooltips.

tokens.name: sh-lg
tokens.usage: Toasts and the Reconnecting pill.

tokens.name: sh-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, the command palette and the open phone sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-btn
tokens.usage: Secondary and danger buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Primary and good buttons: a hairline highlight on top of the solid fill.

tokens.name: card-highlight
tokens.usage: Layered under sh-xs on every card; a top highlight that only shows in dark.

tokens.name: tabbar

tokens.name: control-sm

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Button md, IconButton icon, Input, Select, TextArea first row.

tokens.name: control-lg

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Badge and Kbd height.
